output.narrative: Pictures and brief questions have supported the child's storytelling and sharing. When recalling a picnic with two friends, the child shared a short account and used a picture prompt to remember what happened next. In a small group, the child retold the beginning and middle of a familiar story, with a teacher's question needed to explain the ending. These examples show the child putting events into words, with support for parts of the sequence. The child also named familiar book characters, answered a simple who question, and shared a group-time idea with a little prompting.

图片、等待时间和简短提示，为孩子用中文分享提供了帮助。从跟着教师说出小猫、小狗的名称，到看图说出几个熟悉的动物名称，孩子在运用这些词语表达图片内容。最近介绍喜欢的动物时，孩子补充了颜色和动作细节，并回应了一个简单追问，较长的回答则需要先停下来组织语言。孩子也用两三个短句介绍自己的画，在角色扮演中表达“我要苹果”等需要。讲述三张图片的先后顺序时，孩子能说出短句，说明图片间的联系仍需教师帮助整理；遇到不熟悉的词语，会用手势或向教师求助。

Arranging objects helps the child keep track when counting. Earlier, the child counted four toy animals with one-to-one pointing; in the recent pretend shop, the child used this approach for groups up to ten. Scattered objects still benefit from arranging before counting, and a reminder to move each shell helped the child correct a missed item. Pattern work has moved from copying red-blue blocks and independently adding two more to creating a two-colour pattern and spotting a break in its sequence. The child also explained colour sorting choices, used more and fewer correctly when comparing counters, and checked one more than five by counting all the counters.

A teacher's introduction helped the child join a paired building task, and a brief reminder of the next step helps during transitions. In shared play, the child asked a classmate for a turn with a toy truck and waited with a reminder while the classmate finished. During drawing, the child invited a friend to join and offered crayons to share. When both wanted the same colour, the child asked the teacher for help. These moments show the child using requests, invitations and adult help to take part in activities with peers.
